europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: The Ceuta migration crisis has prompted EU ministers to unite behind Spain, signalling a coordinated response to the influx of migrants. The incident highlights the EU's ongoing challenges in managing irregular migration flows.

top_stories.title: Togo Becomes New Entry Point for Russian Weapons to Mali
top_stories.summary: Togo has become a new entry point for weapons sent by Russia to Mali, according to a France 24 report. The development raises concerns about the flow of arms into conflict zones in West Africa.

top_stories.summary: A bombing at a Moscow restaurant has sparked nationalist fury, with critics pointing to elite privilege and security failures. The incident has intensified domestic tensions amid ongoing war rhetoric.
